# infisical_pam_folder_identity (Resource)

Manage a machine identity's membership in a PAM folder, which grants its role on every account in the folder. The machine identity must already be a PAM member. Only Machine Identity authentication is supported for this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder" "dbas" {
  name = "dbas"
}

resource "infisical_pam_identity" "ci" {
  identity_id = "<identity-id>"
  role        = "member"
}

resource "infisical_pam_folder_identity" "ci_dbas" {
  folder_id   = infisical_pam_folder.dbas.id
  identity_id = infisical_pam_identity.ci.identity_id # also makes Terraform add the identity to PAM first
  role        = "connector"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `folder_id` (String) The ID of the PAM folder. Changing it creates a new membership.
- `identity_id` (String) The ID of the machine identity. Changing it creates a new membership.
- `role` (String) The role on every account in the folder: `admin`, `operator` (sessions and credentials), `connector` (sessions only) or `auditor` (audit logs and recordings).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the membership.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the machine identity's folder membership by folder ID and identity ID
terraform import infisical_pam_folder_identity.example <folder_id>:<identity_id>
```
